verdict.rationale: Intel's general Core Ultra marketing states AI acceleration is built in via CPU/GPU/NPU engines, and official SDKs/runtimes (OpenVINO, oneAPI, oneDNN, DirectML, ONNX RT, WebNN) are documented and ship today, satisfying the SDK/runtime half of the story. However, none of the evidence gives a published NPU TOPS figure (with precision stated) specific to the 285K desktop chip — the cited pages are generic Core Ultra platform copy, not confirmation of this exact SKU's NPU rating or Copilot+ eligibility. Missing for 10: a concrete NPU TOPS number with stated precision for the 285K, and confirmation the desktop chip's NPU meets AI PC/Copilot+ thresholds.
